  "salary_min": null,

  "contract_type": "Toàn thời gian",
  "working_hours": "Thứ 2 - Thứ 6 (từ 08:00 đến 17:30)\nParticipate in after‑hours/on‑call support when required for major incidents.",
  "benefits": [
    "Annual salary review (once per year).",
    "Dynamic, technology-driven working environment with opportunities for self-development and career advancement.",
    "insurance, annual leave, and 13th-month salary in accordance with state regulations.",
    "Participation in Social, Health, and Unemployment Insurance (BHYT, BHXH, BHTN).",
    "Annual health check-up.",
    "Participation in sports activities, workshops, birthday celebrations, team building, and company trips on a quarterly and yearly basis."
  ],
  "description": "* Provide daily application support including monitoring, troubleshooting, and resolving incidents for assigned applications.\n* Analyze system issues by understanding application logic, data flow, and business rules; work closely with development teams to validate findings.\n* Coordinate with internal teams (infrastructure, development, security) and vendors to ensure timely resolution and effective communication.\n* Support problem management by conducting root‑cause analysis (RCA) for recurring or high‑severity issues.\n* Maintain high‑quality technical documentation, including system flow diagrams, troubleshooting steps, application inventories, deployment procedures, and SOPs.\n* Participate in application enhancement and new system development activities, including requirements clarification, understanding design documents, and supporting UAT/testing.\n* Perform backend checks (e.g., SQL queries, system logs, configuration validation) to support issue investigation.\n* Prepare regular reports including incident summaries, trend analysis, and improvement recommendations.\n* Participate in after‑hours/on‑call support when required for major incidents.",
  "requirements_text": "Requirements:\nTrên 5 năm kinh nghiệm chuyên môn  Cao Đẳng trở lên\n\nCandidate Requirements\n* Proficiency in English (written and spoken) to communicate with regional teams and vendors.\n* Minimum 5 years of experience in Application Support, IT Operations, or a similar technical role.\n* Solid understanding of application architecture:\n  + System design concepts\n  + Backend–frontend interaction\n  + API and integration flows\n  + Database structure and queries\n* Ability to read and interpret basic code logic (e.g., Java, .NET, Python, SQL) to understand root causes—actual coding not required.\n* Familiarity with SDLC (Software Development Life Cycle) and Agile/Waterfall development methodologies.\n* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, able to break down complex issues into understandable components.\n* Experience with ITIL processes (Incident, Problem, Change).\n* Good documentation skills: flowcharts, SOPs, troubleshooting guides, user manuals.\n* Basic experience using SQL and working with application logs.\n* Ability to work under pressure and manage communication during critical issues."
}
